gameDescriptionHtml:
Hit like you mean it with FieldSENSE powered by BOOM Tech. Experience how the new physics-informed dynamic tackling system unlocks realistic collisions & new gameplay animations on both sides of the ball.

BOOM Tech – Hit like you mean it with FieldSENSE powered by BOOM Tech. Experience realistic collisions and new gameplay animations with a physics-informed tackling system, re-engineered hit stick, and ball carrier balance.

Physics-Based Tackling – Cut loose and attack with powerful hit sticks, cut sticks, trucks, dives, and stiff arms with more control than ever, a new physics system considers timing, momentum, weight, speed, strength, and player ratings for authentic outcomes.

Reloaded Hit Stick – The re-engineered hit stick uses a timing-based mechanic to provide harder-hitting control determined by your angle of impact, stick-skill, and accuracy for cut sticks, big hits, and trucks with more realistic physical movements and results.

Ball Carrier Balance – A new ball carrier balance and recovery system gives you control to absorb a big hit, break the tackle and recover your balance based on the quality of the hit and the ratings of the players involved.

Game Features

  • FRANCHISE IMMERSION – Recharged Franchise mode provides a rebuilt NFL Draft experience featuring Roger Goodell, team and rookie records, new environments, personalized storylines, more ways to customize your NFL team and season, a fresh Super Bowl celebration experience, and Franchise Central with simplified league creation tools and more information at your fingertips so you can drive your Franchise to victory.
  • LIVE UPDATES IN ULTIMATE TEAM & SUPERSTAR – New rewards, feature releases, themed programs, and the ability to customize your style and skills in Superstar bring refreshed experiences across Ultimate Team and live game modes.
  • PLAYBOOK EXPANSION – Evolve your strategy with a brand new set of featured plays, from some of the game’s most inventive team playbooks.
  • TEAM BUILDER – Create your own NFL franchise using Team Builder, a web-based customization tool that allows you to design a team that perfectly matches your style.
